# Cncf Visual Studio Code Kubernetes Tools Reviewer

Review Visual Studio Code Kubernetes Tools using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Application Definition &amp; Image Build category. The extension for developers building applications to run in Kubernetes clusters and for DevOps staff troubleshooting Kubernetes applications.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
